data_description.api_key: An admin-scope key from Kinwall Settings → API keys. Needed to register the push webhook.

abort.already_configured: This Kinwall server is already configured

data.chore_points: Points for chores created from Home Assistant

external_url_required.title: Kinwall can't push updates to Home Assistant
external_url_required.description: Kinwall at {url} is not on your local network, so it can only reach Home Assistant through an external URL. Set one under Settings → System → Network → Home Assistant URL → Internet, then reload the Kinwall integration. Until then the integration polls every 30 seconds instead.

import_recipe.name: Import recipe
import_recipe.description: Adds a recipe from another app (such as a meal kit) to Kinwall's recipe library, or updates it if it was imported before, and optionally plans it. Needs an admin API key.

config_entry.name: Kinwall
config_entry.description: Which Kinwall, when more than one is set up.

source.name: Source
source.description: Where the recipe comes from. With the ID, it identifies the recipe, so importing it again updates it.

external_id.name: Recipe ID
external_id.description: The source's own ID for the recipe.

source_url.name: Recipe card link
source_url.description: Link to the recipe card, saved as the recipe's source link.

image_url.name: Image link
image_url.description: Link to a photo of the dish.

servings.name: Servings
servings.description: How many servings the ingredient amounts are for.

ingredients.name: Ingredients
ingredients.description: A list of lines like "1.5 tablespoon Sour Cream", or objects with text, pantry and category. pantry: false means it ships in the kit, so grocery lists leave it off.

steps.name: Steps
steps.description: A list of steps, saved as numbered instructions.

plan_date.name: Plan on
plan_date.description: Also plan the recipe on this date, unless that slot already has a meal. The response says whether it was planned.

plan_slot.name: Plan for
plan_slot.description: Which meal of the day to plan it for.

plan_servings.name: Planned servings
plan_servings.description: Servings for the planned meal. Defaults to the recipe's.

plan_meal.name: Plan meal
plan_meal.description: Plans a meal on Kinwall's meal planner: a recipe from the library, or just a name. Needs an admin API key.

config_entry.name: Kinwall
config_entry.description: Which Kinwall, when more than one is set up.

title.name: Title
title.description: The meal's name. Needed unless you give a recipe ID.

recipe_id.name: Recipe ID
recipe_id.description: A Kinwall recipe ID, such as the recipe_id from Import recipe.
